evidence_quotes:
All vehicle shortcomings will be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance
Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated) (DA Pam 738-750) immediately after the PMCS, and before
taking corrective action.
statements.reason: The source specifies these forms for all vehicle shortcomings found during PMCS.
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the shortcoming must be reported on DA Form 2404 (Equipment Inspection and Maintenance Worksheet) or DA Form 5988-E (automated).

statements.reason: The source requires equipment-record reporting for deficiencies, but does not state that this shortcoming is a deficiency or that all shortcomings receive that reporting.
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the shortcoming will be recorded in the equipment record.

evidence_quotes:
a. Inspect starter for mounting
security. Tighten mounting bolts to
40 lb-ft (54 N•m).
statements.reason: The starter PMCS procedure specifies that torque for its mounting bolts.
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the specified tightening torque for the starter mounting bolts is 40 lb-ft (54 N•m).
